images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE high-end game VFX concept artwork for SSLM (东方神话艺术化写实PBR), a redesigned FIREBALL IN FLIGHT. Wide 16:9 art-director review board, rich cinematic quality but clear restrained emission, technically legible shapes. This is concept art, not a UE screenshot.
Composition: left 70% a single continuous three-quarter isometric view (camera about 30 degrees down) of an oriental village stone courtyard with subtle moss, distant timber architecture and green foliage, gently defocused. A neutral silver humanoid caster at lower left and a neutral silver training target at upper right provide scale, neither obscured. ONE fireball is clearly airborne midway toward the target, no impact yet, traveling from lower left toward upper right on a graceful broad curved flight path. The projectile should dominate the main panel; visible diameter about 60cm compared with a 180cm mannequin. Right 30% a large isolated close-up of THE SAME projectile, same head-to-tail direction, against blue-gray neutral background, a thin elegant divider.
Design of projectile: distinct compact near-spherical, slightly fore-aft compressed three-dimensional head, solid volumetric silhouette filled with rolling fire, NOT a hollow ring or flat spiral ribbon. Small platinum-white hot nucleus occupies less than 10% of visible head. Thick flowing golden yellow and amber-orange middle flame shell, deep vermilion/orange folds give real depth, asymmetrical soft curled orange-red outer licks swept backwards. Warm fire palette centered on #F16B46, amber-gold highlights and tiny warm white peaks. Silhouette is sculpted, full, round and readable with genuine thickness from every direction; no rock or metal surface. Fine internal flame currents and cloudlike vortices, larger continuous folds, no harsh noisy filigree. Trailing behind: exactly THREE identifiable broad tapered semi-transparent flame streams, with offset helical phase progression (0/60/120 degrees), weaving softly into a cohesive wake following the curved flight history, widest near the head, naturally thinning to drifting embers; clear gradient from luminous gold near head to red-orange and almost transparent at tail end. Tail about 2.5 times head diameter, not a continuous laser beam from caster. Sparse fine embers. A subtle close-fitting heat haze refracts stone lines immediately around the projectile and wake; no visible glass orb, no full-screen distortion. Physical warm light spill on nearby paving, faint soft airborne shadow. Strong surface detail remains visible, preserve small white area, no bloom clipping or thick bright outlines.
Layout/text: elegant crisp Chinese heading at upper left EXACTLY '火球飞行 · 赤金流焰'. Small right inset caption EXACTLY '弹头与尾焰近景'. Small footer EXACTLY '设计概念图 · 待人工审核 · 非UE实机'. No additional text, no stats or fake UI. Rendered art, sophisticated game concept sheet, clean color separation, no film grain, no fake sharpen, no wirelike trail, no S-shaped empty sheet replacing the ball, no explosion, no ground lava, no opaque smoke cloud hiding target.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE high-end game VFX concept artwork for SSLM (东方神话艺术化写实PBR), a redesigned ICE CRYSTAL PROJECTILE IN FLIGHT. Wide 16:9 art-director review board, cinematic material quality and readable restrained glow. This is concept art, not a UE screenshot.
Composition: left 70% one continuous three-quarter isometric view (camera about 30 degrees down) of an oriental village stone courtyard with subtle moss, distant timber architecture and green foliage, gently defocused. A neutral silver humanoid caster at lower left and neutral silver training target at upper right provide scale and remain readable. ONE ice crystal projectile is airborne halfway along a broad graceful curved flight toward the upper-right target, no hit or explosion yet. Projectile prominently visible, core body about 65cm long and 35cm wide compared with 180cm mannequins. Right 30% a large isolated close-up of THE SAME projectile with same orientation, on blue-gray neutral background; a thin elegant divider. Match a professional paired fire/ice projectile design sheet in camera, lighting, panel proportions and typography.
Design of projectile: a substantial tapered elongated three-dimensional crystal spearhead with a sharp forward tip, thicker faceted heart and stepped narrowing rear; ONE unified dominant head, not a flower, lotus, ball of glass leaves or uniform blue block. Three smaller asymmetric swept-back supporting crystal fins grow from the same crystalline body, hugging its shape instead of forming a crown. True transparent pale blue ice with thickness, refraction, internal multiple-facet reflections, selective frosted fracture planes and sharp but very thin highlight edges. Facets vary in size and angles with many broad clean faces, not noisy tessellation. Readable sapphire-blue inner energy nucleus with modest icy-white highlights, no opaque white fill or heavy contour. Cold blue palette #409CE5 with pale #C4DCFF, clear ice and deep azure interior. Tail: THREE softly twisting separate frost/energy streams with staggered helical phase progression 0/60/120 degrees, broad near the rear and smoothly narrowing along the curved flight history, gradually dissolving to a soft ice-blue vapor wake about 2.5 head lengths. A few small thin translucent ice splinters travel in the wake, extremely sparse pinpoint glints. Mist reveals motion without hiding the faceted head or characters. A restrained local air-pressure/refraction shimmer hugs head and wake; no visible enclosing glass sphere, no thick circular shockwave, no full-screen blur. Faint cool light on ground directly beneath projectile and a soft airborne shadow; no frozen path, ground spikes or impact burst. Natural material interplay between blue transparent body, bright internal reflections and soft pale vapor; clear silhouette, fine edges, smooth highlights, no bloom washout.
Layout/text: elegant crisp Chinese heading at upper left EXACTLY '冰晶飞行 · 霜蓝棱晶'. Small right inset caption EXACTLY '晶体弹头与冷雾近景'. Small footer EXACTLY '设计概念图 · 待人工审核 · 非UE实机'. No additional text, no stats, no fake editor UI. Detailed production concept art, realistic stylized PBR ice, no plastic, no stone, no thick white borders, no snowstorm, no film grain, no artificial sharpening, no explosion.
